item.title: Sunlounger Travel hosts leader of the opposition Kemi Badenoch and local MP at agency HQ
item.description: Boss Iain Kirkbright gave North West Norfolk MP James Wild and Tory leader Badenoch an overview of the challenges facing agents during a visit to Sunlounger's King's Lynn HQ on Monday (23 March)

item.title: African Pride sales head David Holland to retire after 40 years+
item.description: David began his career as a travel agent before joining Qantas Jetabout in 1987, moving to Travel 2 in 1990, where he spent 16 years as Sales Director, before moving to Gold Medal. He joined African Pride in 2011 and became a co-owner in 2017.

item.title: EasyJet to offer 22 routes from new three-aircraft base at Newcastle airport
item.description: New routes taking off from Newcastle include Antalya, Malta, Tenerife and Sharm-El-Sheikh

item.title: New social media-based agency brand launches to 'future proof' Bolsover Cruise Club
item.description: Odysia Cruise officially launched in October and within days had landed its first booking – a 14-night sailing on P&O Cruises' Ventura ship

item.title: InteleTravel distances itself from Katie Price's new travel business after industry backlash
item.description: A now-deleted post advertising a livestream about joining Katie Price Travels caused outrage earlier this month, but InteleTravel tells TTG Price has not joined the agency's ranks

item.title: Cruise.co.uk and Ambassador team up for country music voyage
item.description: Departing from Tilbury, Essex, on March 25, 2027, the four-night cruise will host a number of themed events onboard the 1,400-guest Ambience. Country music quizzes, dining, silent discos and fitness sessions will feature, alongside line dancing classes and open mic sessions for aspiring singer-songwriters. Tribute acts to Johnny Cash, Shania Twain, Lainey Wilson and Luke Combs will perform, alongside bands including The Charmed and Britt & The Backbeat.

item.title: Virgin Voyages unveils winter 2027/28 programme
item.description: Brilliant Lady will operate voyages from Los Angeles calling at destinations in the Mexican Riviera, Pacific Coast and Panama Canal before transitioning into a Caribbean winter season, sailing from Miami. In addition, the ship will sail a series of seven-night Mexican Riviera cruises, as well as a 17-night Panama Canal sailing from Los Angeles to Miami with visits to Cabo San Lucas, Puntarenas, Cartagena and Puerto Quetzal.
